stories.h: Coastal flood warning for Snohomish shoreline Thursday morning
stories.s: Low-lying coastal areas could see 2.5-3.5 feet of water from 3 to 10 a.m. as tides peak before sunrise. A wind advisory may down limbs; Snohomish PUD has extra crews ready for outages.

stories.h: Lynnwood passes budget, makes school-zone cameras 24/7
stories.s: Lynnwood's council approved a 2027-28 budget 6-1 and, in a split 5-2 vote, expanded speed cameras, including round-the-clock school-zone enforcement and two new cameras on 44th Ave W, projected to raise $8.2 million.

stories.h: Guilty plea in deadly 2024 south Everett robbery
stories.s: Martin Alvarez, 20, admitted second-degree murder in a December 2024 dating-app robbery near Silver Lake that ended in a fatal shooting. Both sides recommend 18 years; sentencing is set for Jan. 5.

coming.s: Santa lights the tree just after 5 p.m. at Colby and Hewitt; food trucks, music and free movies start at 2 p.m.

coming.h: Stuff a Bus food and toy drive begins
coming.s: Everett Transit and Volunteers of America collect food and toys 10 a.m.-4 p.m. at the Bothell-Everett Highway Fred Meyer, weekends through Dec. 13.
